design.purpose: A warm two-colour chunky scarf for one adult, worked flat in single crochet: green for the first half and blue for the second half. Yarn amounts must be checked before starting because yardage is not visible.

steps.c: Place green yarn, blue yarn and hook on the work surface.
Ch 16. Row 1: sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-18: ch 1, turn, sc in each of 14 sts across.
Change to blue in the last stitch of row 18.
Rows 19-36: ch 1, turn, sc in each of 14 sts across.
Fasten off and snip blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Snip green starting tail to 15 cm if longer.
Weave each tail through 3 sts, then back through 2 sts.
Lay scarf flat, smooth edges, check 28 cm by 84 cm.
